shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; git log --oneline | head; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

cat index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Table/index.d.ts && cat Table/Table.d.ts && ls Table/hoc && cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSettings/withTableSettings.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120

cat Pagination/Pagination.d.ts Pagination/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---SORT-IMPL; sed -n 1,200p Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js; echo ---SEL-IMPL; sed -n 1,160p Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js; echo ---TEXT; grep -n "variant" Text/Text.d.ts | head; echo ---LABEL; grep -n "theme" Label/Label.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts | head -20 && grep -n "size\|view" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -10 && grep -n "variant" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3 || grep -rn "TextVariant\|TEXT_VARIANTS" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -3

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/index.d.ts && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/DataTable.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""  type TableColumnConfig,
  type TableDataItem,
  type TableSortState,
} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';""","""  type TableColumnConfig,
  type TableDataItem,
  type TableProps,
  type TableSortState,
  type WithTableSelectionProps,
  type WithTableSortingProps,
} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';""")
s=s.replace("""const EnhancedTable = withTableSorting(withTableSelection(Table)) as typeof Table &
  ((props: any) => JSX.Element);""","""type EnhancedTableProps<I extends TableDataItem> = TableProps<I> &
  WithTableSortingProps &
  WithTableSelectionProps<I>;
const EnhancedTable = withTableSorting(withTableSelection(Table)) as unknown as <
  I extends TableDataItem,
>(
  props: EnhancedTableProps<I>,
) => JSX.Element;""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 && echo TSC_OK && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8

(ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer") ; echo "---done"

cat > /tmp/patch.ts <<'EOF'
EOF
sed -i '/^const FIRST_NAMES = \[/,/^const STATUSES/c\
const PEOPLE = {\
  male: {\
    first: ["Иван", "Дмитрий", "Сергей", "Алексей", "Павел", "Михаил", "Андрей", "Николай"],\
    last: ["Петров", "Кузнецов", "Васильев", "Михайлов", "Фёдоров", "Волков", "Лебедев", "Егоров"],\
  },\
  female: {\
    first: ["Анна", "Мария", "Елена", "Ольга", "Наталья", "Екатерина", "Татьяна", "Юлия"],\
    last: ["Иванова", "Смирнова", "Попова", "Соколова", "Новикова", "Морозова", "Алексеева", "Семёнова"],\
  },\
};\
const DEPARTMENTS = ["Разработка", "Дизайн", "Маркетинг", "Продажи", "Поддержка", "Финансы"];\
const POSITIONS = ["Junior", "Middle", "Senior", "Lead", "Head"];\
const STATUSES: EmployeeStatus[] = ["active", "active", "active", "vacation", "dismissed"];' src/data.ts
sed -i 's/    const firstName = pick(FIRST_NAMES);\n//' src/data.ts
perl -0pi -e 's/    const firstName = pick\(FIRST_NAMES\);\n    const lastName = pick\(LAST_NAMES\);/    const person = rnd() < 0.5 ? PEOPLE.male : PEOPLE.female;\n    const firstName = pick(person.first);\n    const lastName = pick(person.last);/' src/data.ts
sed -i "s/\"/'/g" src/data.ts
sed -n '14,32p;60,66p' src/data.ts && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && git status --short
grep -n "person\|firstName\|lastName" src/data.ts | head && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -3 && rm -rf dist && git status --short
